items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: So he heard of me and called me at my hotel, and said, 'Come on. Would you like to go with me? I'm going up to British Columbia on a theater tour.' ... So four days I worked, and then finally I left to go with Noble Sissle, up in British Columbia, Seattle, Portland, San Francisco.

ctx.x: When Charlie was performing and you performed with him and you watched him perform, were people dancing? Did he perform his band that he was with or were they just jam sessions,
Nobody was dancing. They came to listen.

I told you the story of how Noble didn't understand what Charlie was doing, in an earlier tape around--- where there was Noble's band and Noble turned we were doing "Honeysuckle Rose"-and Noble looked at me and he scratched his head.
